id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID for this [Seeed Mr60Bha2](https://esphome.io/components/seeed_mr60bha2/) component if you need multiple components.

*See also: [Seeed Studio MR60BHA2 60GHz mmWave Breathing and Heartbeat Detection Sensor Kit](https://esphome.io/components/seeed_mr60bha2#configuration-variables)*

uart_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the [UART Component](https://esphome.io/components/uart) if you want to use multiple UART buses.

*See also: [Seeed Studio MR60BHA2 60GHz mmWave Breathing and Heartbeat Detection Sensor Kit](https://esphome.io/components/seeed_mr60bha2#configuration-variables)*

has_target.docs:
If true when target (person) is detected. All options from [Binary Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/binary_sensor#config-binary_sensor).

*See also: [Seeed Studio MR60BHA2 60GHz mmWave Breathing and Heartbeat Detection Sensor Kit](https://esphome.io/components/seeed_mr60bha2#configuration-variables)*

breath_rate.docs:
**float**: Radar-detected respiratory rate during the first 60 seconds. All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [Seeed Studio MR60BHA2 60GHz mmWave Breathing and Heartbeat Detection Sensor Kit](https://esphome.io/components/seeed_mr60bha2#configuration-variables)*

distance.docs:
**float**: Straight-line distance between the radar and the monitoring object. All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [Seeed Studio MR60BHA2 60GHz mmWave Breathing and Heartbeat Detection Sensor Kit](https://esphome.io/components/seeed_mr60bha2#configuration-variables)*

heart_rate.docs:
**float**: Heart rate during the first 60 seconds as detected by the radar. All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [Seeed Studio MR60BHA2 60GHz mmWave Breathing and Heartbeat Detection Sensor Kit](https://esphome.io/components/seeed_mr60bha2#configuration-variables)*

num_targets.docs:
**int**: The number of target detected by the radar. All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [Seeed Studio MR60BHA2 60GHz mmWave Breathing and Heartbeat Detection Sensor Kit](https://esphome.io/components/seeed_mr60bha2#configuration-variables)*
